Fable 5.2 goes up close. You can see the ruined inner ring, the seating and the arena floor.

Opus 5.5 builds the whole thing as a diorama on a base, with the full… https://t.co/5alUKEFfLa pic.twitter.com/TyVN3SwmMx

Everything in this video is running live in a browser—with zero 3D models (.glb), zero textures, and zero MP3s.

One prompt to Claude Fable 5.2: "bring a 3D castle to life in an HTML file."

What came back: a hamlet riding a giant snail through a valley. Hand-written WebGL2, no libraries, no assets, full day/night cycle, ~5,500 trees, real-time shadows.

Try it: https://t.co/DB3bp1K3K8 pic.twitter.com/RqACDTUJXi
